instruction: Our office wiki should be reachable by everyone in the office on port 8080 of this server, but colleagues' browsers can not connect. Strangely, when I open http://localhost:8080 on the server itself I see a wiki page, but it looks old. Please make the real, current wiki reachable from other computers on port 8080. It must still ask for the office login (user 'office'). The accounting server on port 9000 must keep running.
